## 6 Element 15's one route: the employee's current orders, served from the read model and from nothing else.

The handler holds the projection and no write model, so the read path cannot drift into the aggregate (http.no-write-model-in-read). The contract of element 11 asserts no page on this collection and element 15 says the list has no pagination, so the route takes no paging parameters and answers items alone; a page would be a bound no source names (element 11 Q-11-1).
